content.description: Tourist₳ came up with the idea to offer NFTs in the tourism theme. Charles Hoskinson has already seen a lot of the world, but he also takes the time to discover monuments and places of interest. He captures this with a photo selfie and would like to share it with you. Every photo selfie is unique, destinations can change, but attributes are also added that have specific meanings for Charles. Charles can be seen wearing a cowboy hat, funny sunglasses, traditional Mongolian hat, cigar, ice cream, micro,... Or a mix of all of this.
